description: AdaptiveWindow 0.4.2 for released Hytale 0.7.0: place glazing as native transparent quads inside each structural model; generate donor-textured masonry as separate model pieces outside the aperture union; keep every architectural frame on fixed UVs and give all 21 items explicit icons and dimension-prefixed English names.
changes: Replace every placed particle-pane attachment with a double-sided native quad whose face has transparent=true; set RequiresAlphaBlending=true and remove all legacy particle systems
Restore the original Pilot model's native glazing face rather than the 0.6.8 particle workaround
Build wall infill from the complement of the union of aperture polygons inside an odd-width, block-aligned installation envelope
Map only adaptive_wall nodes to the six donor texture slots; keep frame boxes at the fixed stone UV and glass in four shared palette sheets
Keep outer frame members deep enough to project from the masonry while inner tracery remains thin
Derive names from block envelope dimensions and English style names; retain 3x7x1_window for the original
Generate 21 transparent 128x128 item icons from the actual models and register explicit Icon paths
Preserve stable IDs, material definitions, learned aliases and all 84 prior multipart footprints
Install only the shared 0.4.2 JAR, with checksum validation and recoverable backup of 0.4.1
advantages: Pane, frame and block orientation use one model transform, eliminating independent particle offsets and rotations
Selected wall material cannot recolor the frame or glazing because their atlas regions are disjoint and validated across all states
Curved and circular windows show donor masonry outside their aperture without rectangular glass corners
No saved-world conversion and no runtime asset registration
Explicit names and silhouettes make the creative inventory catalogue usable
disadvantages: The 0.7.0 pack decodes about 172.78 MiB of RGBA texture pixels; client GPU/FPS impact is unmeasured
A rectangular installation envelope means the rose is surrounded by adaptive masonry even though its visible frame and opening are circular
Software inspection and dedicated-server validation do not certify final client transparency, lighting or aesthetics
The combined block still has one break lifecycle rather than independently breakable wall, frame and panes
test_results: 29137 static checks passed: models, UVs, references, icons, English names, transparent faces, panel transforms, wall/aperture coverage and frame/wall material isolation
Native Hytale 0.7.0 create: 7215 checks over 21 models at four yaw rotations
Native reload/removal: 13163 checks; all 84 placements persisted and removed through multipart filler routing
Native learned-material restart: 6711 checks; new and previous aliases remained available
All 84 model/yaw cases retained the 0.4.1 occupied cell sets and filler offsets exactly
Installer fixture passed, then shared install replaced only 0.4.1 with 0.4.2; four other mod files stayed identical and no saved world was opened
Client visual rendering and performance remain unverified

metrics.reliability: Static plus native create/reload/learnreload validation passed
metrics.maintainability: One parametric generator and one shared glazing atlas per donor material
metrics.performance: 45293568 decoded texture pixels; client FPS/GPU unmeasured
metrics.compatibility: Released Hytale 0.7.0; existing IDs and multipart footprints retained
